Between May and July operatives rented safehouses and bought trucks used as bomb vehicles.
Simultaneous suicide vehicle bombings of US Embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam killing over 200.
Faxes to a London-based Arabic newspaper claimed the bombings for the Islamic Army for the Liberation of the Holy Places.

key_claims: Al-Qa'ida is a highly skilled, resilient network with a wide range of attack methods.
Bin Ladin's operations rest on an extreme interpretation of Islamic law sanctioning attacks on US and allied civilians and military.
Al-Qa'ida emphasizes meticulous pre-operational planning and casing, as in the 1998 East Africa bombings.
Al-Qa'ida has refined its tactics and operational security amid crackdowns after the millennial plots.
Al-Qa'ida-directed cells in Jordan and a trained operative (Ressam) in Canada plotted anti-US attacks in December 1999.
Bin Ladin is hosted by the Taliban in Afghanistan, where al-Qa'ida camps train operatives.
